name: What are the biggest mistakes in bathroom expansions?

mainEntity.name: What problems do homeowners run into most often during bathroom expansions?
mainEntity.text: What problems do homeowners run into most often during bathroom expansions?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest bathroom expansion mistakes usually happen before construction starts. Poor layout planning can leave the room feeling awkward even after it gets larger. Moving plumbing too far from its original location can add cost quickly and create avoidable complications. Many homeowners also underestimate hidden issues behind the walls, such as water damage, old pipes, or bad framing. Another common mistake is selecting oversized fixtures that crowd the room and defeat the purpose of the expansion. Ventilation and storage are often overlooked too, even though they affect day-to-day comfort more than a fancy finish does. A successful expansion should be planned around how the bathroom will actually be used. That means checking circulation, clearances, storage, lighting, moisture control, and cleaning access before demolition. The best projects look simple in the finished result because the hard decisions were made early. Homeowners who plan carefully usually get a bathroom that feels larger, works better, and causes fewer surprises during construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: The most common mistakes are poor layout planning, moving plumbing too far, underestimating hidden damage, choosing fixtures that are too large for the room, and failing to plan ventilation and storage. These mistakes make the expansion more expensive and less functional.
